title: Book One · Chapter 122: The Last Two Books
story:
Miss Wu opens the small storage room. She takes Ronan to the drying table. Leo comes too. She only asked Ronan, but Leo wants to help.

“I have two hands,” Leo says.

“So does Ronan.”

“Then we are a good team.”

Miss Wu looks at their four hands. “Keep all of them clean.”

The last two exercise books are dry. Their pages turn, but the edges still wave. One cover has a pale brown mark.

Ronan lifts that book. He opens it near the middle. A small blue line has run down the page.

“We did not save it properly,” he says.

“You kept it safe from more rain,” Miss Wu says. “That matters too.”

Leo holds the second book against his chest.

“This one can be a mountain book. You draw on the hills.”

“We must show Mr Qiu.”

After school they carry both books under Ronan's coat. There is only a light rain, but they do not trust it. Mum meets them at the school gate and shares her umbrella.

At the little table Mr Qiu opens each book. He turns every page. A customer comes for a pencil. He asks the boys to wait, sells the pencil, and gives the woman her change.

Then he comes back to the books.

“These cannot go with the new ones.”

Ronan looks down.

“I know.”

Mr Qiu gets a pencil and writes on two small pieces of paper. He puts one in each book.

“Marked books. Lower price.”

“Will someone want them?” Leo asks.

“Someone may. Someone can still write on the pages.”

He sets them at the far end of the table, apart from the flat, clean books. Ronan reads the signs twice. The marks are not hidden.

“Could I buy one?” he asks Mum.

“Do you need one?”

Ronan thinks. His school exercise book is half full. He has loose drawing paper at home.

“I want Mr Qiu to have the money.”

Mr Qiu hears him. He rests his hand on the grey table.

“Keep your money. I can sell the books myself.”

Ronan looks up.

“But we helped with it.”

“And I thank you. Now let me sell the books.”

Leo steps back from the table. He sees a friend on the road and waves. Then he runs under the umbrella again as the rain grows heavier.

That evening, a man stops for paper. He needs a book for lists in his kitchen. Mr Qiu shows him the wavy pages. The man rubs the brown cover, asks the price, and buys it.

Ronan is inside the gate. He wants to call Leo at once, but Leo has gone home. Instead he tells Mum in a quiet voice. He watches the man walk away with the book. He is glad the man wants it.

One marked book remains. Mr Qiu puts it away with the others at supper time.

Ronan helps carry an empty box. He leaves the last book to its owner. Mr Qiu has put a price inside. Someone may want to use it tomorrow. Ronan leaves it on the table.

On Monday Leo asks, “Are both books gone?” Ronan tells him about the man with kitchen lists.

“A mountain kitchen,” Leo says.

“We should not write that on the cover.”

“I know.”

Leo opens his own flat exercise book. He has drawn a cake on the last page. It is leaning to one side. Ronan laughs, and Leo adds a hand to hold it up.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：marked＝有污痕的；apart from＝与……分开放；change＝找零。

情节提示：storage room＝储物间；umbrella＝雨伞；cover＝书封面。

理解：1. Mr Qiu 怎样出售受潮后留下痕迹的本子？2. 为什么 Ronan 最后没有买？
